block.name: r3 runs exactly the candidate the gate checked
r1 routes r3's LAN over the r1-r3 link, and the table holds still
r3 routes h1's LAN over the r1-r3 link
A trace from r1 reaches h2 through r3 directly
The live routes of every router, read after the change, equal the model the candidate passed
